name: Business email compromise / account takeover
description: A user's mailbox or cloud account is taken over (phishing, token theft) and used for fraud or data theft.

steps.text: Review sign-in logs for the account: risky sign-ins, unfamiliar IPs/countries, session tokens reused from new devices.
List mailbox rules, forwarding and delegated access; search the audit log for which emails/attachments were read or exported.
Revoke all sessions and refresh tokens, reset the password, and re-register MFA with phishing-resistant methods.
Remove malicious inbox rules and forwarding; block the external forwarding address and the phishing domain.
Contact Payments immediately: freeze or recall any payment instructed by the compromised account; warn the supplier through a known phone number.
Purge the phishing email from all mailboxes and identify other recipients who clicked.
Enforce conditional access / token protection for executives, and run targeted phishing awareness for finance staff.
